- **One language per repo** — detected by extension p"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"lurality across git-tracked files; override with `--language`.

runtime reads them down. The"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" two share no other contract."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- **Publishing is atomic** — a reindex writes a new snapshot, then flips the `current` pointer via `"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"os.replace`. A query reading the old snapshot keeps working; no downtime window.
- **The runtime pat"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"h never writes** — every query opens the published snapshot read-only (`mode=ro&immutable=1`).
- **T"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"he package graph is rebuilt, not accumulated** — each reindex clears that repo's outgoing edges befo"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"h is rebuilt, not accumulated** — each reindex clears that repo's outgoing edges before recomputing."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Full detail: `docs/system-architecture.md`"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Indexing CLI reference"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"Known upstream limitations"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- **`scip-java` can't index Android/Gradle repos** — its Gradle plugin keys off standard source sets"},{"id":"p45s2","text":" that AGP replaces (scip-java#177).
